dedupe_keys.name: applying machine learning to the analysis of railway accidents in brazil

description: Applying Machine Learning to the Analysis of Railway Accidents in Brazil is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Diego Pascoal de Souza. This study applies machine learning to official railway accident data from Brazil’s National Land Transport Agency (ANTT) to identify key factors influencing accident severity. The research proposes predictive solutions and targeted prevention strategies, while also exposing critical data limitations and advocating for the responsible use of AI in managing critical infrastructure. Coverage: national (BR); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
